name: Akazukin to Mayoi no Mori
source:
After Tiana is lost in the Forest of Hesitation she meets various people with all dark secrets. Her own past is also revealed and the curse of the forest has more to do with her than she ever could imagine.

[From [url=http://yumiisdream.blogspot.com/2011/06/game-review-akazukin-to-mayoi-no-mori.html]Yumii's Dream Factory[/url]]
translation:
蒂亚娜在迷失之森迷了路。她在那里遇见形形色色的人，每个人都隐藏着黑暗的秘密。她自己的过去也随之揭开，而森林的诅咒与她的关联，比她所能想象的更深。

[摘自[url=http://yumiisdream.blogspot.com/2011/06/game-review-akazukin-to-mayoi-no-mori.html]Yumii's Dream Factory[/url]]
